Sound familiar?

She’s great at everything else. Dating just doesn’t add up.

  • The career, the friends, the life: built on purpose. Dating still feels left to chance.
  • The apps bring plenty of matches, and very few men worth a second date.
  • The ones who look perfect on paper never seem to feel right in person.
  • She knows exactly what she wants, but can’t tell which “must-haves” are actually getting in the way.

Here’s what you’ll learn

The 5 steps we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Rewiring your beliefs

The quiet stories about men and dating that shape who you say yes to, and how to rewrite them.

Finding your blind spots

The patterns that keep bringing the same kind of man back into your life, and how to spot them early.

Making room for a relationship

Why a full, successful life can leave no space for a partner, and how to create it without giving anything up.

Getting into the right rooms

Where the men you actually want are spending their time, on the apps and off them.

Preferences vs deal breakers

How to separate the two, so you stop filtering out the right man for the wrong reasons.
